2. Description of In-Clinic Consultation & Fulfillment

Our website facilitates appointment booking for one primary healthcare service:

In-Clinic Personal Diagnostic Consultation (Standard ₹1,000 / Online Prepaid ₹800)

  • Service Description: A dedicated 30-minute, one-on-one in-person clinical diagnostic assessment conducted by Dr. Surabhi Vaidya at our clinic in Thane West.

(Note: Any therapeutic Panchakarma procedures or medicines that may be recommended are discussed separately and are not included in this consultation booking fee).

  • Payment Options: The standard consultation fee is ₹1,000 payable at the clinic reception upon arrival. Patients who choose to confirm their slot in advance by paying online receive a 20% discount (₹800).

3. Purpose of the Website Lead Form (Direct Scheduling)

The brief intake form on this website is designed solely to collect patient contact information and joint concern (knee, back, or both) in order to coordinate and confirm an in-clinic consultation appointment.

The form does not constitute a medical diagnosis, diagnostic test, or clinical prescription. A definitive medical assessment requires an in-person physical examination and report review by a qualified doctor.

4. Clinical Scope & Realistic Expectations

Ayurvedic therapies, clinical care recommendations, and Panchakarma procedures administered at Charak Health Solutions are customized according to each patient's individual constitution (Prakriti), medical history, and clinical stage of joint wear.

Health outcomes and relief timelines inherently vary among individuals depending on age, chronicity, severity of cartilage or disc wear, lifestyle adherence, and existing co-morbidities. Charak Health Solutions does not offer guaranteed cures, fixed-percentage pain relief guarantees, or absolute surgery-avoidance claims. In severe structural situations (such as complete bone-on-bone Stage 4 loss or severe nerve compromise), Dr. Surabhi Vaidya provides clear, objective clinical guidance, including surgical referrals where medically warranted.

🚨 Medical Emergency Notice

The services provided through this website are intended for non-emergency chronic joint, back, and musculoskeletal conditions. They are not suitable for acute medical emergencies. If you are experiencing sudden acute trauma, loss of motor control or limb sensation, cauda equina symptoms (sudden loss of bladder or bowel control), or excruciating unmanageable pain, please contact your local emergency services immediately or report directly to the nearest hospital casualty / emergency department.
